questions.q: What happened to Israel Hands after he fell from the shrouds?
choices: He sank and lay dead on the sand under the water
He swam to shore and escaped
He climbed back onto the ship
He was picked up by the pirates' boat

questions.q: What frightened Jim most while he was pinned to the mast?
choices: The thought of falling into the water beside the dead coxswain
The pain of the wound in his shoulder
The idea that Silver would arrive
The darkness coming on
questions.evidence: it was the horror I had upon my mind of falling from the cross-trees

questions.q: How did Jim finally get free of the dirk?
choices: A shudder tore away the pinch of skin holding him
He pulled the dirk out with both hands
He cut his sleeve with his own knife
The ship rocked and the dirk fell out
questions.evidence: it held me by a mere pinch of skin, and this the shudder tore away

choices: It bled freely but was neither deep nor dangerous
It broke his shoulder bone
It left him unable to use his arm
It was only a tiny scratch that did not bleed
questions.evidence: it was neither deep nor dangerous

questions.q: What did Jim do with O'Brien's body?
choices: Tumbled it overboard
Buried it on the beach
Locked it in the cabin
Left it lying on deck
questions.evidence: with one good heave, tumbled him overboard

questions.q: Why was Jim no longer very afraid of the dead body?
choices: He had grown used to tragic adventures
He did not know O'Brien was dead
The doctor had taught him not to fear the dead
It was too dark to see the body
questions.evidence: the habit of tragical adventures had worn off almost all my terror for the dead

questions.q: What did Jim do about the main-sail to protect the ship?
choices: Cut the halyards so the sail dropped
Raised it to catch the wind
Folded it neatly on the deck
Tied it to a tree on shore
questions.evidence: At last I got my knife and cut the halyards

questions.q: How did Jim get from the ship to the shore?
choices: He dropped overboard and waded in water up to his waist
He rowed a small boat
He swam a long way in deep water
He walked down a gangplank
questions.evidence: The water scarcely reached my waist

questions.q: How did Jim expect Captain Smollett to react to his news?
choices: He hoped the captain would admit Jim had not wasted his time
He feared the captain would send him home
He expected the captain to give him the treasure
He thought the captain would not care
questions.evidence: I hoped that even Captain Smollett would confess I had not lost my time

questions.q: Near Ben Gunn's area, Jim "walked more circumspectly." What does circumspectly mean?
choices: Carefully, watching all around
Quickly and noisily
In a large circle
Happily, whistling as he went
questions.evidence: I walked more circumspectly, keeping an eye on every side

questions.q: What worried Jim about the glowing fire he saw between the two peaks?
choices: Silver might see it too
It might spread to the stockade
It meant the ship was burning
It would scare away the animals
questions.evidence: might it not reach the eyes of Silver himself

questions.q: Why did the large fire near the block house make Jim fear something was wrong?
choices: The captain had ordered them to be sparing with firewood
His friends never cooked at night
The fire was burning the stockade
Fires were forbidden by Ben Gunn
questions.evidence: by the captain's orders, somewhat niggardly of firewood

questions.q: What sound made Jim feel relieved as he crawled toward the house?
choices: People snoring loudly in their sleep
The doctor's voice calling his name
A guard calling "All's well"
The parrot squawking
questions.evidence: it was like music to hear my friends snoring together

questions.q: What did Jim plan to do once he was inside the dark block house?
choices: Lie down in his own place and surprise everyone in the morning
Wake the captain to report at once
Search for food and water
Hide in a corner until daylight
questions.evidence: I should lie down in my own place

questions.q: Who announced Jim's arrival in the block house?
choices: Silver's parrot, Captain Flint
Dick, the pirate on guard
The doctor
Ben Gunn

questions.q: What is the big surprise at the end of the chapter?
choices: The block house is held by Silver's pirates, and Jim is caught
Jim's friends throw a party for him
Ben Gunn has captured the stockade
The HISPANIOLA has sailed away
questions.evidence: the voice of Silver cried, "Who goes?"
